title: FREE BEST BUY GIFT CARD!!
description: Official Rules:  1. You MUST be subscribed to this channel!  2. You MUST have your parents permission if you're under 18. I'll be sending this gift card to your mailbox in real life (obviously), so I don't need parents telling me that I'm sending their kids gifts. I don't roll like that.  3. You MUST submit a comment/video response saying WHY you want this gift card, and/or WHAT you would do with it! Video responses are ultra win, so.. no hints or anything..  4. PLEASE keep checking your YouTube mailbox for the next week! I may be sending updates/results to them! THAT'S HOW YOU WILL BE NOTIFIED THAT YOU WON.  5. DO NOT make multiple accounts to enter. Trust me.. I can tell you're doing it.    GOOD LUCK! And thanks for making this contest possible!      (I am not affiliated/sponsored by Best Buy in any way. All uses of their logo/gift card is copyright to Best Buy.)
